title: Practicum Intern
bio: Muniza Kadiwala is a Practicum Intern at Riaz Counseling, supporting clients experiencing anxiety, depression, stress, self-esteem challenges, coping difficulties, and life transitions. Muniza’s primary areas of focus include anxiety, depression, and life transitions, while also working with individuals experiencing mood disorders. Muniza provides individual and group therapy services for adults (20–64) and older adults (65+). Drawing from approaches including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Integrative Therapy, Person-Centered Therapy, Solution-Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT), and Strength-Based Therapy, Muniza creates a supportive and compassionate environment that encourages healing, growth, and positive change.
